records.real_world_identity_notes: The PMR identity is best matched to the 1980 Ford Zakspeed Capri Group 5, the 1.7-litre turbocharged Division 1 Super Capri developed by Zakspeed for Ford and the German Racing Championship. Mücke Motorsport Classic identifies its surviving Ludwig car as ZAK-G5C 001/80 in Division 1, later renumbered ZAK-G5C 002/80 for one Division 2 race in late 1980; that chassis-number change was a passport change for the same vehicle. The PMR page's 1.7-litre, five-speed and 580-hp description fits the 1980 Division 1 specification more closely than the earlier 1.4-litre Division 2 cars, although the simulator does not expose a chassis number or livery that proves one individual historical chassis.
records.confidence_basis: The official PMR vehicle page names the Ford Zakspeed Capri Group 5 and gives the 1.7-litre, 5-speed and 580-hp configuration. Independent exact-period and owner/restorer records identify the 1980 Zakspeed Capri Division 1 specification, including the 1.74-litre engine, five-speed Getrag gearbox, chassis history and Group 5 DRM use.
